validation.scope: initial CPU/memory/resume implementation before requested disk admission correction
controls: synthetic resource caps and existing load
stale completed-output hashes are never reused
science identity excludes admission policy but includes source binding
one trivial child plus exact-PASS resume at a changed worker width

disk_correction_validation.reason: Root independent review requested enforcement of the pilot contract's 4 GiB scope admission budget.
disk_correction_validation.controls: Admission allowed below both thresholds; blocked at 4 GiB scope bytes or at 256 MiB filesystem free reserve.

actual_resource_observation.meaning: Existing load reduces admission without stopping all work; selecting ncp does not bypass the host cgroup quota.

contracts.disk_checks: scope file bytes and filesystem free bytes sampled before new job admission

limitations: PASS verifies child exit and declared output integrity; scientific acceptance belongs to the worker.
Resource admission is sampled and estimate-based, not a kernel-enforced memory limit.
The scope disk cap gates new admission only; active jobs may finish with outputs beyond the cap. This is not a kernel output quota.
cgroup v2 is inspected; the memory estimate must include the worker's full memory footprint.
Caller supplies explicit source, input and toolchain binding plus bound-file hashes.
Incomplete prior attempts remain blocked to prevent duplicate work; terminal retries require an explicit flag.
NCP execution and actual scheduler scaling were not performed by this author.
